//: Governance guardrail config for the OPA `governance` package, passed to conftest via --data. Each guardrail is INERT until you populate its parameter, so this ships safe-by-default: copy the examples in the comments into real values to turn a guardrail on. The state-safety policies (backend_key, no_unexpected_destroy) are separate and always on.
//allowed_regions: Data residency. List the Azure regions resources may target; empty = no restriction. Example: ["eastus", "eastus2"]
//required_tags: CAF tagging governance, enforced on the types in tag_enforced_types. Empty = off. Example: ["environment", "owner", "data_classification"]
//allowed_subs_per_env: Deploy-to-wrong-subscription guard. Set `environment` to the env this run targets and map each env to its approved subscription GUIDs. Absent env key or empty list = inert.
//enforce_private_network: Require public network access disabled (private-endpoint posture). Default true. Set false to allow public access (not recommended for regulated workloads).
//enforce_secure_transport: Require storage HTTPS-only + TLS 1.2+. Default true.
